verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-driven activate, suspend (pause), and permanently close a card, plus updating linked balance accounts, which covers core lifecycle states. However, evidence does not explicitly document 'unpause' as a distinct reversible action, nor a dedicated 'report lost or stolen' status/endpoint, nor a reissue/replacement flow that links a new card to the original. missing for 10: explicit unpause/resume endpoint, lost/stolen reporting mechanism, reissue-with-linkage-to-original-card documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of these flows.
